setup.title: Set up Kokpit
setup.intro: A few questions. Skip any of them; everything can be changed later.
setup.lang.title: Language
setup.name.title: Your name
setup.name.help: Used only in the greeting. Leave it empty if you like.
setup.name.label: Name and surname
setup.place.title: Where you are
setup.place.help: Your city is looked up once on OpenStreetMap to find local events and the weather.
setup.place.zero: 0 events: the source may not cover this city. You can still go on.
setup.place.none: No match. Try another spelling or add the country.
setup.place.offline: The map service could not be reached. Skip the city for now; it can be added later.
setup.news.title: News topics
setup.news.help: Each topic has a name, keywords and the RSS or Atom feeds to read. Nothing is built in; leave it empty to keep the digest off.
setup.news.feedhelp: Finding a feed address: many sites link one as RSS or Atom, often at /feed, /rss or /atom.xml. Paste the full address starting with https://.
setup.news.name: Topic
setup.cv.title: Your CV
setup.cv.help: Paste the text of your CV. Kokpit suggests skills and languages from it; nothing leaves this machine.
setup.model.title: Model
setup.model.help: Optional. A model can write short summaries. Without one, Kokpit shows numbers and lists only.
setup.model.hermes_missing: The command {bin} was not found. Install Hermes or pick another option.
setup.model.key_help: Any OpenAI compatible service. The key is saved to the .env file next to kokpit.toml and never shown again.
setup.model.key_set: A key is set. Leave it empty to keep it.
setup.model.none_help: No model. You can add one later.
setup.model.summaries: Let the model write summaries (digest, weekly career note)
setup.sum.title: Summary
setup.sum.help: Check your answers. Finish saves them and opens Kokpit.
setup.sum.name: Name
